prompts.name: pond
prompts.prompt: Produce ONE complete horizontal landscape 2D playable game background, aspect exactly 2680:1550 (1.729:1). This is an edit of image 1, an authoritative FLAT COLLISION STENCIL in a fixed screen-space layout. Register the boundary and junction to image 1 edge to edge. Replace every flat color, remove all guide marks. Do not crop, zoom, rotate, outline the entire map, or add UI. Image 2 is the ACTUAL game's honey-house courtyard, art direction reference only: that same softly sculpted hand-painted gouache look, warm upper-left sunlight, little moss cushion highlights, leaf veins painted in shape groups, ochre reflected light, natural shadows, foreshortened side profiles, delicate material changes, appealing storybook botanical illustration. Image 3 reference contextual botanical marks. Create local bee-scale landscape: player sees just a 46%-width crop. No bee, humans, creatures, collectible flower heads, pickable glowing objects, signs, buildings, interface, text, bridge, map border or labels. Camera fixed, obliquely looking down on ground; show SIDE FACES of raised terraces and roots, taller rocks and blades. Paint rich believable middle-size landmarks at each third; every crop should have three clear depth planes and a focal arrangement. Amber guide line is FLOW only; convert into intermittent groups of soil and soft irregular grass clearings discontinuously dissolving into green moss, never a hard path or continuous road. Keep the middle flyway quiet in value relative to margins, at least a fifth of screen height across, leave room for playable flower sprites and bee. Natural partial groundcover and leaf shadows across open acres break up bare lawn. Asymmetric, composed, bold shapes; no rim of uniform pebbles everywhere. No illustration frame; paint all four sides. Image 1 turquoise = pond, olive-green is a continuous low vegetated peninsula, with the ONLY short bay branch extending DOWNWARD at 56% canvas width. Both upper AND lower edges of the peninsula touch water at EXACT silhouette. Turn the unplayable upper/back water into a jade pond with rich submerged pebbles, soft cottony water reflections, a softly hazy FAR bank at the TOP edge with muted sage woodland, a few arcing reeds and reflected light. Suggest a tiny weathered amber earthenware jug with wild vine beside the left approach like the pottery in the courtyard (at x .14, immediately inside upper island rim, grounded); bend at x .32 edged by a low honey-coloured rocky scarp; southward bay tip x .56 at y .85 of the full card marked by an asymmetrical sculptural pair of brown-tipped bulrushes rooted at its LEFT edge and water lilies in the water to its left. Far rounded sunlit basalt rocks and coppiced willow on rightmost far end flank. Large, dark, close, cropped water plants in bottom corners and warmly backlit leaf tips echo courtyard framing. Only a few lily pads, human-scale rocks and reeds; avoid tiny repeated texture, island rock ring, cartographic aesthetic. Warm moss and sun-splashed ochre on land; teal-jade, muted cool deep shadows.
